prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: Impeccable dashboard composition decision comp for Astrid Nails & Beauty Bar. Structure: RITUAL PATH — the interface reads as one calm treatment journey from choose to confirm to arrive to complete to remember; customer side has a refined navigation header, Welcome back Francis, a prominent horizontal appointment-stage path with the current stage highlighted, upcoming appointment detail, a Book appointment action, and quiet history beneath; admin side groups Today’s appointments by Pending, Confirmed, Completed, Cancelled with one exceptions-first strip and concise rows. Input image: the approved Soft Luxury Salon public-site comp is the style reference; carry over only its off-white porcelain ground, deep navy type, plum primary actions, blush accents, restrained brass details, refined serif-plus-clean-sans character, fine lines, and photographic polish; do not copy its landing-page hero, navigation, or content. Style/medium: production-grade accessible desktop SaaS UI, soft luxury salon identity, graceful status ribbon and hairline timeline, operationally familiar controls. Palette: warm white #F8F5F1, deep ink #17172E, plum #6C147E, blush #E8649A, restrained brass #B69A42. Text to render legibly where possible: Astrid Nails & Beauty Bar; Welcome back, Francis; Your appointment; Choose; Confirmed; Arrive; Complete; Book appointment; Today’s appointments; Pending; Confirmed; Completed; Cancelled. Constraints: first viewport only, realistic working interface, no invented ratings, awards, revenue, certifications, or customer counts; no gradients, no excessive pill containers, no all-rounded-card grid, no device mockups, no people, no watermarks, no illegible pseudo-text. Dense staff queues must remain directly scannable.
